# TracerNest

> Free, open-source, zero-dependency Node.js and Laravel 13 logger with an embedded web dashboard, hardware AES-256-GCM encrypted log vault, and zero extra open ports.

TracerNest (`tracernest-logger` on npm) is a modern, privacy-first, self-hosted telemetry flight recorder designed as a lightweight Errsole and Winston alternative. It attaches directly to existing HTTP request pipelines (Express, Koa, Fastify, Laravel), capturing persistent logs with zero extra open ports and zero runtime dependencies (`dependencies: {}`).

- [npm Package: tracernest-logger](https://www.npmjs.com/package/tracernest-logger): Official npm package with zero runtime dependencies.

- [Contact & Support](https://tracernest.info/contact.html): Direct developer communication, GitHub Discussions #26, and community reviews.
- [Engineering Blog & Guides Hub](https://tracernest.info/blogs.html): Interactive directory of 10 in-depth production guides and benchmarks.
- [Laravel Logging Dashboard](https://tracernest.info/laravel-logging-dashboard.html): Dedicated self-hosted Laravel 13 logging dashboard and Monolog telemetry bridge with zero extra ports.

## Technical Guides & Architecture Deep Dives

- [Errsole Alternative for Node.js: Why Zero-Port Telemetry is Replacing Heavy APM Daemons](https://tracernest.info/errsole-alternative-nodejs-zero-port-telemetry.html): In-depth comparison of Errsole vs. TracerNest showing how attaching directly to the app port eliminates secondary TCP ports and reduces 45+ npm dependencies to zero.
- [How to Encrypt Application Logs with AES-256-GCM in Node.js (Zero Dependencies)](https://tracernest.info/encrypt-application-logs-aes-256-gcm-nodejs.html): Step-by-step guide on implementing hardware-accelerated authenticated log encryption at rest using Node's standard crypto module with zero external dependencies.
- [Self-Hosted Logging in Laravel 13: Bridging Monolog with Zero Extra Ports](https://tracernest.info/self-hosted-logging-laravel-13-monolog-bridge.html): Complete integration guide for Laravel 13 PHP 8.2+ Monolog handler and unified telemetry bridge.
- [Zero-Downtime SQLite to MySQL Auto-Migration: Production Architecture Guide](https://tracernest.info/zero-downtime-sqlite-to-mysql-migration.html): Architectural guide on how TracerNest detects schema drift, applies non-destructive DDL, and migrates SQLite records into MySQL with zero downtime.
- [Eliminating Supply Chain Vulnerabilities in Node.js Observability Pipelines](https://tracernest.info/eliminating-supply-chain-vulnerabilities-nodejs.html): Explains why zero runtime dependencies (`dependencies: {}`) in package.json completely eliminates npm supply chain CVEs and prototype pollution risks.
- [Global Telemetry Architecture: Self-Hosting Logs Across US, EU, and APAC](https://tracernest.info/global-telemetry-architecture-self-hosting-logs.html): Multi-region self-hosted telemetry architecture maintaining strict GDPR, SOC2, and HIPAA data residency across 9 countries.
- [How to View Express.js Logs in a Web Dashboard Without Opening Extra Ports](https://tracernest.info/express-log-viewer-without-extra-ports.html): Step-by-step tutorial on mounting TracerNest directly into an existing Express 4 or Express 5 HTTP pipeline to view live encrypted logs without firewall changes.
- [Winston vs. Pino vs. TracerNest: Choosing the Best Node.js Logger in 2026](https://tracernest.info/pino-vs-winston-vs-tracernest-comparison.html): Architectural comparison of Winston, Pino, and TracerNest examining dependency sprawl, CPU overhead, log viewer UI availability, and at-rest payload encryption.
- [Distributed Tracing in Docker & Kubernetes Microservices with Zero SaaS Bills](https://tracernest.info/microservices-distributed-tracing-sqlite-mysql.html): How to architect high-throughput correlation IDs across multi-container Docker and Kubernetes deployments while replacing high Datadog and Sentry SaaS per-gigabyte ingestion fees.
- [Building a High-Performance Node.js Logger with Native Standard Libraries](https://tracernest.info/node-js-logger-zero-dependencies-guide.html): A deep dive into utilizing `node:crypto`, `node:http`, and `node:sqlite` to craft an enterprise-grade observability engine without installing a single third-party npm package.

## Global Telemetry & Regional Compliance

- [United States Telemetry Node](https://tracernest.info/united-states.html): Self-hosted telemetry for US enterprise microservices under SOC2, HIPAA, and major cloud providers (AWS, GCP, Azure).
- [India Telemetry Node](https://tracernest.info/india.html): RBI data localization compliance and high-throughput fintech microservice telemetry.
- [Netherlands Telemetry Node](https://tracernest.info/netherlands.html): EU GDPR compliance and low-latency AMS-IX cluster deployment architecture.
- [Poland Telemetry Node](https://tracernest.info/poland.html): Central European tech hub logging with strict GDPR data sovereignty.
- [Canada Telemetry Node](https://tracernest.info/canada.html): PIPEDA compliance and local data residency for Canadian enterprise workloads.
- [Germany Telemetry Node](https://tracernest.info/germany.html): Strict German BSI security standards and isolated on-premise log storage.
- [United Kingdom Telemetry Node](https://tracernest.info/united-kingdom.html): UK GDPR and FCA financial audit compliance.
- [Brazil Telemetry Node](https://tracernest.info/brazil.html): LGPD compliance and South American cloud infrastructure deployment.
- [Ireland Telemetry Node](https://tracernest.info/ireland.html): Irish Data Protection Commission compliance for European digital headquarters.
